source_evidence: Exact-head diff against main changes only src/jev_factorio/lua/factory.lua and tests/test_factory.py.

campaign.transfer retains assert(player.can_reach_entity(machine), "Transfer is out of reach") before destination selection, inventory capacity checks, source.remove, target.insert, and receipt mutation.

For a non-extracting coal transfer to a burner furnace, the new branch selects machine.get_inventory(defines.inventory.fuel) before the existing furnace_source branch; extraction behavior and all non-coal routing remain unchanged.
The diff contains no teleport, speed, movement, mining, or inventory-grant logic.
Added Lua tests prove coal reaches the fuel inventory rather than furnace_source and that an unreachable furnace causes no source, fuel, or receipt mutation.
